description: Post-hoc diagnostic cases for causal inference classification.

cases.evidence: A code update was deployed at 14:00. The integration test passed at 14:15.
cases.claim: The code update caused the integration test to pass.
cases.label: insufficient

cases.evidence: The investigation confirmed that the integration test passed because the CI configuration was corrected. The code update had no effect on the test outcome.
cases.claim: The code update caused the integration test to pass.
cases.label: contradicted

cases.evidence: The team conducted a controlled comparison with identical test conditions. The test failed without the code update and passed with it. The team confirmed that the update fixed the failing test.
cases.claim: The team confirmed that the code update fixed the failing integration test.
cases.label: supported
